capabilities: Output Markdown from Dataview DQL query code blocks
Run Dataview JS via eval() and output Markdown strings from dv.markdownTable, dv.markdownList and dv.markdownTaskList
Insert and update Dataview publish blocks via commands
Automatically update output blocks on file save
Narrow updates to files matching a configured Dataview source
disambiguation: Not a standalone publishing tool; it generates updatable Markdown blocks and relies on the core Publish plugin to publish them.
extras: Installed through the BRAT beta installer rather than the community plugin store. Dataview JS is labeled experimental and executes code via eval(), with a warning to only run trusted code. The installation section appears to contain a copy-paste error, telling users to enable the 'Checkbox Time Tracker' plugin.
problem: Dataview query results only render live in notes and do not persist as Markdown or appear in Obsidian Publish sites.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses the following two plugins, so you must install them: - Dataview
This plugin highly inspired by this article. Using Dataview on Obsidian Publish

summary: Generates updatable Markdown output from Dataview queries in code blocks, ready to publish via the Obsidian Publish core plugin.
